anti_generic_signature_read: A round dark field filled by two opposed graduated gold-gear spirals, curved alternating spokes, dark through-core and recessed orange annulus distinguishes this from a generic clock or exposed-gear ornament.
blind_action_read: Round 2 informed rereview: the Wish was already known. Before reading state descriptions, I inspected all 45 decoded display frames from 48 declared states, plus full-size frames 0, 1, 2, 23, 39. The 24 operating samples 0–23 span 0–64.6875°: both gear chains orbit while individual spokes spin; the central sun, orange disc, stem and base remain fixed. Bezel cap positions move with the carrier. Fine steps resolve earlier aliasing. Later segments reset the carrier, then show separate small-cap and main-cap unscrewing and base-lid withdrawal, not fixed-center gear rotation. Official state descriptions confirmed these identities after the fresh read. No gross collision is visible in the sampled operating excerpt; it is not a full revolution. Prescribed digital motion does not prove continuous collision clearance, drive contact, physical transmission, balance, coasting or printed fit. Numerical and physical confidence remain separate from this visual verdict.

Separately, 238 fixed-center BRep contact samples passed, and pedestal/stem full-turn clearance bounds have measured/derived PASS evidence; neither establishes complete coupled collision clearance or physical transmission. resolution: Visual form and presented-action review passes on repaired round 2 evidence, after preserving the failed initial review and its correction. The dark field and added gear coverage resolve the prior silhouette issue; actual oblique views confirm recessed orange, hollow core, bezel and quiet trimmed base; fine operating samples show simultaneous orbital and individual wheel motion. The apparent flat orange shading is classified as renderer/material uncertainty, not a visible geometry departure after exact depth views. This passing visual judgment covers modeled form and intended motion presentation only; actual translucent glow and all physical performance remain unverified. No print-ready claim. Original naive reads remain in blind-review/current-blind-*.json; round2 fresh observations, corrections and scope are retained separately. The Wish was revealed only after the original blind read and was already known during this rereview.
